title: Business Development Executive
description:
Business Development Executive
Forest of Dean
£35,000 per annum

title: Business Development Executive
description:
Our client, a well-established business within the manufacturing and engineering industry, based in Tewkesbury, has an exciting opportunity for a commercially minded Business Development Executive to join their team on a full-time, permanent basis. This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys winning new business, building long-term customer relationships and getting involved in technical projects from the initial conversation through to completion. The role offers plenty of autonomy, with the opportunity to make a real impact on the company's continued growth. Although the company is based in Tewkesbury, requirement to visit the site will be 1 day a week.

The successful Business Development Executive should have:
- A strong sales and business development background, with a proven ability to identify opportunities, win new business and grow existing accounts
- An engineering or manufacturing background, or previous experience selling technical products or services within a B2 B environment
- The ability to read and interpret technical drawings, or a willingness to develop this knowledge
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the confidence to engage with customers, understand their requirements and develop long-term partnerships
- A proactive, commercially driven approach, with the motivation to take ownership of a sales pipeline and see opportunities through from initial enquiry to completion
- The flexibility and willingness to travel extensively across the UK, primarily throughout England, including occasional overnight stays

In this role, the Business Development Executive will be responsible for:
- Proactively identifying and pursuing new business opportunities through outbound calls, networking and targeted sales activity
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with new and existing customers, understanding their requirements and identifying opportunities for future projects
- Working closely with customers to understand their technical requirements, using technical drawings and project specifications to help identify suitable solutions
- Managing the full business development process, from initial contact and quoting through to securing projects and maintaining ongoing customer relationships
- Arranging and attending customer meetings across the UK, both face to face and via Teams, to develop opportunities and strengthen existing partnerships
- Maintaining accurate CRM records, monitoring sales activity and providing regular updates on the sales pipeline and business development progress
- Representing the business at exhibitions, conferences and industry events, while using LinkedIn and other platforms to build a strong professional network and increase brand awareness

This is a predominantly field-based role, with regular travel across the UK, primarily throughout England, to meet customers, develop new opportunities and support projects. When not travelling, the successful candidate will work from the company's Tewkesbury office, with occasional visits to the company's office in Scotland. The role will suit someone who enjoys being out meeting customers, developing opportunities and building relationships over the long term, rather than simply focusing on short-term sales.

Our client is offering the successful Business Development Executive a salary in the region of £45,000, plus an attractive benefits package including uncapped quarterly commission, company car, fuel card, 21 days' holiday plus bank holidays and pension.

If you're a sales-driven professional with an interest in engineering, manufacturing or technical products, and you're looking for an opportunity to take ownership of your own sales pipeline while developing long-term customer relationships and projects, we'd love to hear from you. Whether you already have experience in a technical sales environment or are looking to bring your engineering or manufacturing knowledge into a more commercially focused role, this could be an excellent next step in your career. Apply now to find out more and have an informal chat about the opportunity!

title: Graduate/Graduate Calibre Sales Consultant
description:
Graduate Business Development Consultant OR Graduate Calibre

£27k - £30k basic salary + Realistic uncapped £50k 1st Year On Target Earnings + £5.5k per annum car allowance with fuel card + Private Healthcare + Pension

Operating across 30 countries, this market-leading organisation is a major force in sustainability and recycling. As the largest supplier to the NHS and trusted by household names including Tesco and Sainsbury s, the business is entering an exciting new phase of UK expansion and you could be part of it!

We re looking for bright, vibrant, engaging and determined graduates with the ambition to follow in the footsteps of rising stars such as Jenna Meek, Susie Ma, Ben Francis and Steven Bartlett.

If you re ambitious, confident and ready to make your mark, this is an opportunity to build a successful, rewarding career with a global industry leader. You ll be joining an environment where talented graduates can develop confidence, build commercial skills and progress rapidly into leadership and senior roles.

Why This Opportunity Stands Out
- Top-Tier Training: Industry-leading graduate programme within a company boasting 86% employee satisfaction.
- Proven Career Progression: Four graduates have already been promoted into management positions, showing the genuine opportunity to progress and build a long-term career.
- Real Responsibility: Build your own territory, develop relationships and take ownership of your success.
- Big Impact: Join a global company making waves in sustainability and innovation.
- A Career Without Limits: Your progression is driven by your ambition, performance and ability to make an impact.
- Step into a B2 B sales position where you ll:
- Develop new accounts and drive growth within your own territory.
- Build strong relationships with business owners and decision-makers.
- Receive full support with bespoke training tailored specifically for graduates.
- Develop your commercial confidence and communication skills in a fast-paced, results-driven environment.
- Represent a world-leading company known for its expertise in textile and facilities services.

We re Looking For Ambitious, Driven Candidates Who:
- Are confident, engaging and enjoy connecting with people.
- Want to take control of their earnings and build a stellar professional career.
- Are ready to learn, develop and step outside their comfort zone.
- Thrive in a dynamic, target-focused environment.
- Are hungry for structured professional development and rapid career progression.
- Have the ambition to follow in the footsteps of inspiring young entrepreneurs and business leaders.

What s On Offer:
- Work with a sustainability leader trusted by top brands.
- Industry-leading graduate training and development.
- Fast-track your career in a global corporate environment.
- Competitive earnings, exciting challenges and excellent growth opportunities.
- A supportive, ambitious environment where your success is recognised and rewarded.

You could be the next Jenna Meek, Susie Ma, Ben Francis or Steven Bartlett. but ultimately, we re looking for the next you!

If you re ready to unleash your potential, build your confidence and make your mark with an industry leader, don t wait. Apply now and take the first step towards an exceptional career.

title: Home Sales Consultant - Flooring
description:
Our client, the largest UK retailer of carpets and flooring, are looking for sales-driven and customer-focused individuals to join their expanding team of Home Consultants. Working from your own Mobile Showroom (vehicle provided), you will spend most of your time on the road, working with stores, and visiting customers homes every day.

You will have the opportunity to provide customers with great end-to-end service by helping, advising, and measuring flooring. Using your knowledge of exceptional product ranges and in-house software you will bring customers ideas to life in the comfort of their own home and, while doing so, earn a generous commission!

Outstanding customer service skills will be essential as well as the ability to maximise sales via internet leads by presenting suitable products to the customer in their home.

Full, extensive training provided.

Basic salary of £21,850, with OTE of £40,000 £45,000 including commission, plus a generous range of benefits

title: New Home Sales Advisor
description:
We are working with a private residential developer who is looking to recruit New Homes Sales Advisors to join their team across developments in Gloucestershire and Herefordshire.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced new homes sales professional or someone looking to break into the property industry with a background in sales. The client is open to considering trainees who have the right attitude, communication skills and a genuine interest in property.

The Role:
- Welcoming prospective purchasers to the development and providing an excellent customer experience.
- Conducting viewings and showcasing available properties.
- Building relationships with potential buyers and understanding their requirements.
- Managing enquiries and following up with prospective purchasers to maximise sales opportunities.
- Guiding customers through the purchasing process, from initial enquiry through to reservation.
- Maintaining accurate customer records and keeping sales information up to date.
- Working towards sales targets and contributing to the overall success of the development.

The Ideal Candidate:
- Previous experience in new homes sales or residential property sales would be advantageous.
- Alternatively, candidates with previous sales experience in another sector will be considered for a trainee position.
- Excellent communication and customer service skills.
- A confident, professional and approachable manner.
- A proactive attitude with the motivation to achieve sales targets.
- Good organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple enquiries.
- A full UK driving licence and access to transport.

What's on Offer?
- The opportunity to join an established private residential developer.
- Opportunities for both experienced sales advisors and those looking to develop a career in property.
- Training and support for candidates entering the new homes sector.
- A competitive salary and the opportunity to earn commission.
- A structured five-day working week, Thursday to Monday, from 9:30am to 5:00pm.

If you have a background in sales and are looking for an opportunity to develop your career within the property industry, or you are an experienced New Homes Sales Advisor seeking your next move, we would love to hear from you.

title: Tailor Made Sales Consultant
description:
Position: Tailor Made Sales Consultant (up to Executive

depending on experience or skills-set) Full Time / Part Time
Department: Tailor Made Journeys and/or Agency Sales

Location: Cheltenham, but you may be required to work at such other location(s) as the Company may require

Reports to: FIT Manager

PURPOSE:

Using the client brief and subsequent qualifying process this role involves building and pricing creative luxury tailor-made programs for travel across Europe. The Consultant will be responsible for achieving sales and margin goals, along with designing programs which are operationally sound. Ultimately the aim is to exceed expectations of our guests, sales offices and travel advisors so the return to A&K again and again.

Summary
- To design tailor-made FIT programmes for A&K sales offices or travel advisors, checking the feasibility of itineraries and making suggestions as appropriate.
- Meet or exceed set and agreed turnaround, sales, conversion and margin targets.
- To negotiate better hotel and land provider rates rates where possible
- To cost each programme accurately, competitively and to the required level of quality within the agreed time frame whilst maintaining creativity, using the in-house reservations system
- To actively follow up on all new business quoted until a definitive result is obtained.
- On confirmation, set up the file and ensure the reservation system are accurate before handing over to the operator.
- To actively investigate new products and opportunities to achieve greater sales to existing and new clients.
- To check, when requested, costings and itinerary content of programmes which have been set up by other team members.
- To check the final itinerary and Supplier Information Report before it is sent to all suppliers, as required.
- To built strong relationships with a global clientele of luxury travel industry professionals in order to encourage repeat business.

Quality Control / Customer Service:
- To develop an itinerary which is operationally viable from the outset
- To assist managers and operations staff in handling issues as they arise
- To provide Quality Control information to the Manager/Supervisor as required
- To proactively participate in, and provide training on destinations, products and procedures

EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:

Desired Skills-Set:
- A confident, positive attitude
- Strong spoken and written communication skills. A second European language is advantageous
- A Good level of geographical and general knowledge of Europe is advantageous
- Up-to-date knowledge of Outlook, Word, Teams and Excel
- A natural affinity for sales and (over) achieving goals
- A real passion for travel
- Ability to multi-task and work under pressure
- Attention to detail
- A willingness to develop relationships with clients
- Good and effective time management
